what_this_is: Which source's value a field keeps when more than one offered one. `kinds` is strongest first: a value from an earlier kind is never replaced by a value from a later kind. Between offers of one kind, `same_kind_order` decides in its order. A value whose source is not known (a row with no record of who wrote it, or a kind not listed) `holds` (counts as stronger than every listed kind, so nothing replaces it) or `yields` (weaker than every listed kind). A kind may set `confidence_at_least`: an offer of that kind below it is set aside and never wins. Words a source may give instead of a number for its confidence are read through `confidence_words`. A request may send its own `precedence` of this shape instead.

kinds.says: typed, picked or confirmed by a person
set by one of the person's rules
answered by a source the person chose: a provider, an import, an enrichment or a sync

same_kind_orders.says: the offer made latest wins; an offer with no time counts as the oldest
the offer with the highest confidence wins; an offer with no confidence counts as the lowest

unknown_source_choices.says: a value whose source is not known is never replaced
a value whose source is not known gives way to any listed source
